entities.summary: Nikolay Yefimovich Kruchina, was a top Soviet communist official, the administrator of affairs of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union (CPSU) since 1983 and until his death, effectively the party's chief treasurer, responsible for its enormous assets estimated to be worth nearly $9 billion, which have never been located since.
